full_prompt_en: A square monochrome cover-like image is dominated by the blurred face of a young adult looking straight outward. The crop is extremely close: the forehead is cut off at the top, the chin approaches the lower third, and both outer cheeks dissolve into dark shadow. Loose dark hair slips over the left side of the face and masks one eye; the visible eye at right looks toward the viewer from under a deep brow shadow. The nose is the brightest central feature, with a soft gray bridge and near-black nostril. Closed lips sit below it, shaded so that the expression reads severe and inward. The clothing merges into a broad black mass across the bottom half. Behind the head is a flat medium-dark gray field with only a faint tonal variation. Near the lower edge, the uppercase word BLAME appears in thin, narrow white letters spread widely across the width. Each letter stands alone with generous spacing; subtle vertical blur or streaks trail below some letters into the black region. The image has a deliberately low-resolution, defocused photographic finish. Facial edges are not crisp, and gray transitions bloom into one another; a few hair strands remain comparatively sharp. The lighting seems frontal but narrow, isolating the center of the face while the eyes, temples, and lower body retreat into shadow. There are no visible props, setting, or secondary figures. The graphic arrangement makes the face and title function together: a heavy dark upper-to-lower gradient interrupted by pale central skin and small, evenly spaced white text. The mood is bleak, mysterious, and emotionally withheld.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形单色封面式图像由一张直望外侧的年轻成年人面孔占据。裁切极近：额头被顶边切去，下巴靠近下三分之一处，两侧脸颊融进深影。松散深发滑过脸左侧，遮住一只眼；右边可见的眼睛在厚重眉影下望向观者。鼻子是中央最亮的特征，鼻梁为柔灰，鼻孔近黑。闭合嘴唇位于其下，阴影使神情显得严肃而内敛。衣服与下半部宽阔黑团块合在一起。头后是平坦中深灰色域，只有淡淡调子变化。下缘附近，细窄的白色大写 BLAME 字母疏疏地横排。各字母独立，间距宽阔；部分字母下有轻微竖向模糊或拖痕，沉入黑区。图像刻意保留低分辨率、失焦摄影感。面部边缘不锐利，灰调彼此晕开，少量发丝相对清晰。光似从前方但范围狭窄，只把脸中央分离出来，眼、太阳穴及下部身体都退入暗影。没有可见道具、场所或第二个人物。图形安排使脸与标题共同起作用：从上到下厚重暗渐变被中央浅色皮肤和小小等距白字打断。氛围荒凉、神秘且情感收束。
style_prompt_en: The austere monochrome cover treatment uses a narrow grayscale range punctuated by a few pale highlights and thin spaced typography. Extreme cropping and shallow, almost blurred focus reduce the image to broad shadow planes, a soft central light shape, and occasional sharper strands. Black dominates the lower field; medium gray gives only a faint separation behind the main mass. Frontal light fades quickly into deep eye and edge shadows, leaving an intentionally withheld expression. Widely tracked narrow uppercase letters sit low and small, with slight vertical streaking that blends into the dark. The finish is grainy, low resolution, and photographic rather than cleanly illustrated. Emptiness and near-absence of context make the composition severe and mysterious, while the small regular lettering supplies its only measured graphic rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 严峻的单色封面处理在狭窄灰阶中安排少数浅亮高光与细长疏排字母。极近裁切和浅浅近乎模糊的焦点把画面压缩成宽阔阴影平面、柔软中央光形及偶尔较清的细线。黑色占据下方，中灰只在主体后形成微弱分离。前光迅速衰减入深眼影与边缘暗影，故意保留不可读尽的神情。间距宽阔的窄大写字母小小地落在低处，细微竖向拖痕融入暗色。完成度有颗粒、低清晰度而具摄影性，并非清洁插画。空旷和几乎缺席的场景信息让构图严厉神秘，小小规整文字是唯一有节制的图形节奏。
theme_en: An intensely cropped monochrome face above widely spaced BLAME lettering
theme_zh: 高对比黑白近景面孔，下方排列疏开的 BLAME 字母
name: Blame
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
